title: Inaudible sounds used to fingerprint browsers catch AliExpress red handed
summary: Chinese retailer AliExpress has been caught fingerprinting visitors after one of the metrics—an outdated technique that measures inaudible sounds it sends to browsers—impeded a researcher’s ability to use his bluetooth headphones. Each time he loaded AliExpress, the phone audio stopped.
